sql:
select
    t.id as tenant_id,
    t.name as a,
    count(o.id) as b
from tenants t
left join orders o on o.tenant_id = t.id
group by t.id, t.name
order by t.id
note: This request ("Test"/"Test question", columns "a" and "b") had no concrete business meaning to report on, so I produced a minimal one-row-per-tenant placeholder (tenant name as "a", lifetime order count as "b"). Please resubmit with the actual question and named metrics you want.
